title: Chuyên đề thực tế - Toán kinh tế

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply quantitative methods to solve real-world economic and financial problems.
Collect, process, and analyze data to inform decision-making.
Develop and interpret economic models to forecast and analyze economic phenomena.
Understand and apply AI techniques in economic and financial contexts.
Produce clear, structured, and evidence-based reports.
Analyze and critique economic and financial issues, proposing solutions and policies.
Work effectively in teams, contributing to group projects and discussions.
Plan, organize, and manage projects, including setting goals and timelines.
Effectively present findings and arguments to diverse audiences.
Conduct independent research, gathering and evaluating information from various sources.
Identify, analyze, and solve complex economic and financial problems.
Communicate effectively in both written and oral formats.
Use statistical software (Eviews, STATA, SPSS, R, Python, SAS) for data analysis.
Apply mathematical concepts to economic and financial analysis.
Write and execute Python scripts for data analysis and modeling.
Understand and apply economic theories and principles.
Understand and apply financial theories and principles.
